verdict.rationale: GitBook documents its own RESTful API, but nothing in the evidence shows a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent spec for that API, and probes of the common OpenAPI paths all returned 404. The OpenAPI features cover customers adding their own specs to docs pages, which is an adjacent capability and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
